storeInfo.name: Oriental Bar and Grill
storeInfo.tagline: Authentic Asian Cuisine & Grilled Favorites | Cocina Asiática Auténtica y Favoritos a la Parrilla

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal y área de bar.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room and bar area.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Amplio estacionamiento disponible en el lote privado del restaurante.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Ample parking available in the restaurant's private lot.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato ante cualquier inconveniente.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately regarding any issues.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.nameEnEs: Dumplings caseros rellenos de cerdo y verduras, servidos con salsa de soja y jengibre.
products.descriptionEn: Handmade dumplings stuffed with seasoned pork and vegetables, served with a savory ginger-soy dipping sauce.
products.descriptionEs: Dumplings caseros rellenos de cerdo y verduras, servidos con salsa de soja y jengibre.
Rollitos crujientes rellenos de carne picada y vegetales frescos, acompañados de salsa agridulce.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy golden rolls stuffed with seasoned minced meat and fresh vegetables, served with house sweet and sour sauce.
Steamed tender soybean pods lightly tossed with fine sea salt.
Crispy chicken wings glazed with our special house spicy chili sauce and toasted sesame seeds.
Crispy breaded chicken chunks tossed in a sweet, spicy, and savory aroma sauce served with steamed broccoli.

products.nameEs: Carne de Res con Brotes de Bambú y Cebollín
products.descriptionEn: Tender flank steak wok-tossed with fresh scallions and bamboo shoots in a rich savory oyster sauce.
Juicy jumbo shrimp stir-fried with crisp seasonal vegetables in a fragrant garlic sauce.

products.nameEs: Arroz Frito Especial de la Casa
products.descriptionEn: Wok-fried rice tossed with chicken, roast pork, shrimp, eggs, scallions, and carrots.
Soft egg noodles toss-cooked with fresh vegetables, chicken, beef, and shrimp in savory dark soy sauce.
Tender chicken strips simmered in aromatic green curry sauce with coconut milk, bamboo shoots, and fresh basil.
Juicy grilled steak paired with jumbo shrimp glazed in our signature house teriyaki reduction.
Sweet, spiced Thai black tea served over ice with rich condensed milk.
Aromatic green tea infused with natural jasmine blossoms, served hot in a traditional teapot.

products.nameEs: Refrescos de Fuente y Cervezas Asíanas
products.descriptionEn: Choose from classic fountain sodas or selected chilled imported Asian beers (Tsingtao, Sapporo).

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con opciones vegetarianas y platos que se pueden preparar sin gluten bajo pedido. Consulte a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer vegetarian selections and dishes that can be prepared gluten-free upon request. Please ask your server.

faqs.qEn: Do you accept reservations or takeout orders?
faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación, reservaciones por teléfono y pedidos para llevar directamente o por teléfono.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins, phone reservations, and takeout orders placed directly by phone.
